# QS-CFW-1476-90 - Quality specification - connecting rod CFW-1476-90 (1045)

Revision: Rev E  
Plant: P3  
Parts: CFW-1476-90

Scope
This quality specification defines acceptance criteria and inspection requirements for finished connecting rod CFW-1476-90 (CFW-1476-90) forged from material grade 1045. It applies to production and incoming inspection at Plant P3 and establishes the mandatory characteristics that must be verified prior to release to final assembly.

Requirements table

| Characteristic | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Hardness | The hardness range for connecting rod CFW-1476-90 (CFW-1476-90) is 35-39 HRC. |
| Bore diameter tolerance | The bore diameter tolerance for connecting rod CFW-1476-90 (CFW-1476-90) is ±0.03 mm. |
| Maximum forging weight | The maximum forging weight for connecting rod CFW-1476-90 (CFW-1476-90) is 48.9 kg. |

Inspection method
- Visual inspection: Confirm absence of surface discontinuities, folds, or laps that compromise fit or function. Record observations on the traveler.
- Dimensional inspection: Measure critical bore using calibrated bore gauge appropriate for the dimension and compare to the bore diameter tolerance specified in the requirements table.
- Hardness testing: Perform hardness checks with a calibrated Rockwell tester at locations representative of the bearing interfaces. Verify results against the hardness range specified in the requirements table.
- Weight verification: Weigh the finished forging on certified scales and confirm it does not exceed the maximum forging weight specified in the requirements table.

Nonconformance handling
- Any part failing to meet a requirement in the requirements table shall be segregated and documented as nonconforming. Disposition options include rework, use-as-is under engineering authorization, or scrap.
- Nonconformance records must include the characteristic failed, measured result, and the chosen disposition. Corrective action shall be initiated for recurring failures to eliminate root cause and prevent recurrence.
